extracted.name: Sweet Potato Salad
extracted.description: This roasted sweet potato salad recipe is a delicious lunch or side dish! If you're making it in advance, wait to add the dressing and the avocado until right before you eat.
ingredient_lines: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
instruction_lines: Prepare the Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Tahini Dressing according to the recipes.

Assemble the salad on a large platter with the arugula, a drizzle of dressing, the sweet potatoes, and feta. Top with the avocado slices and squeeze a little lemon juice over the avocado. Drizzle with more dressing and top with the pepitas. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.
